messages:
Iris M: Rivermint has an urgent support ticket — they say throughput on their dedicated pool (rid-42) dropped ~60% since last night's rollout. P50 looks fine but overall QPS has halved. Ticket: https://support/redwood/tickets/4521. Sample req id: req_0a1b2c
Ben K: thanks Iris. model + config? any rollout ids or deploy timestamps?
Iris M: model=redwood-32k-alpha-quant, shard config unchanged. They pointed to a deploy at ~02:08 UTC last night. Attaching the small log snippet they sent:
```
[2026-03-16T02:09:12Z] INFO request=req_0a1b2c route=rivermint-prod model=redwood-32k-alpha-quant latency=198ms tokens=120
[2026-03-16T02:09:12Z] WARN scheduler=frontend queue_wait=320ms exec_time=35ms host=rid-42
[2026-03-16T02:09:12Z] INFO request=req_0a1b2c kv_cache_hit=false
```
Ajay P: queue_wait 320ms looks suspicious — could be batching/backpressure shift. Do we have recent kernel-selector or batching-policy roll?
Deploy Bot: Deployed runtime/release-2026.03.16 to cluster rid-42 @ 2026-03-16T02:10:05Z :rocket:
Sophia L: I can kick off a controlled repro on a staging slice of rid-42. Plan: run the benchmark at their qps, enable kernel selector trace and per-request headers. Command I'll use:
```
./tools/bench_cluster.sh --cluster rid-42 --model redwood-32k-alpha-quant --qps 120 --duration 300 --trace kernel_selector --record-headers
```
Ben K: ping me when you start. Also ask Rivermint to share a small representative trace if possible (their sample reqs help).
Ajay P: while Sophia runs that, can someone check autoscaler logs? if autoscaling oscillated it might have reduced active workers and increased queue_wait. Command: `kubectl -n runtime logs deploy/autoscaler --since=6h | grep rid-42`
Iris M: added the customer engineer's note — they saw sustained backpressure starting ~02:12 UTC. I've given them the repro command too.
Sophia L: started bench now (run id bench-2151234087). Early numbers: steady qps ~118 but median queue_wait jumped to ~280ms vs baseline ~40ms. Uploading kernel_selector trace to GCS: gs://redwood-traces/bench-2151234087/selector.log
Ben K: grabbing the trace. Quick grep shows a sudden fallthrough to kernel variant "kv-quant-v2" on many requests instead of "kv-quant-opt" — that would explain higher exec_time.
Ajay P: good catch. Any recent change to kernel weightings or fallbacks? runtime-bot, can you show the last kernel-matrix commit affecting quant kernels?
runtime-bot: Latest kernel matrix change: commit abc9f2d on 2026-03-15 23:58 by lucas-r — lowered priority for kv-quant-opt under long-seq loads. Diff: https://git/redwood/runtime/commit/abc9f2d
Sophia L: running a quick A/B: force kernel selector to prefer kv-quant-opt for a small slice and re-run bench (bench-2151234300).
Iris M: looping in @Ajay P and @Ben K on the customer thread. I'll tell Rivermint we're running an A/B and will update in 30m. :thumbsup:
Ben K: if the A/B restores throughput we should rollback the kernel-matrix change or adjust the selector heuristics. I'll draft a rollback PR and hold it for review.
Ajay P: also verify KV cache behavior — if selector change accidentally disabled some cache path, throughput would tank. Check host-level logs for `kv_cache_eviction` or `kv_cache_miss` spikes.
Sophia L: A/B finished — when forcing kv-quant-opt the queue_wait drops to ~45ms and throughput returns to baseline. Results: gs://redwood-traces/bench-2151234300/results.json
Iris M: telling Rivermint we have a mitigation and plan (rollback kernel-matrix change + postmortem). They're relieved. I'll schedule a short postmortem meeting and include the customer-facing summary.
Ben K: PR drafted: revert abc9f2d and add a more conservative heuristic for long-seq fallbacks. Assigning to lucas-r for rollback approval.
Ajay P: thumbs up. After rollback let's run a 2h soak on rid-42 and monitor queue_wait, kernel selector distribution, and autoscaler events.
Iris M: thanks team — marking this as high priority. I'll update the ticket and ping the customer once rollback is queued.
Ben K: leaving final checks to tomorrow's morning rotation if anything flaps overnight. Good catch everyone. :clap:
